server.port.description: TCP port on which the LCDd server listens for client connections.

server.host.description: IP address or hostname to bind to. Leave empty to bind to all interfaces.

server.protocol.description: Communication protocol to use. Common values: 'hd44780', 'curses', 'hid'.

server.device.description: Path to the physical LCD device (e.g., /dev/lcd0, /dev/usb/lcd).

server.driver.description: Name of the LCD driver to load (e.g., 'hd44780', 'IOWarrior', 'sure_elec').

server.driver_settings_path.description: Optional path to driver-specific configuration file or settings directory.

server.backlight.description: Initial backlight state: 'on', 'off', or 'blink'. Some drivers accept numeric values (0–7).

server.screen_change_wait.description: Time (milliseconds) to wait before switching to the next screen when multiple clients are active.

drivers.description: List of driver-specific configuration sections. Each element defines options for one driver.

clients.description: List of client definitions that may connect to LCDd. Each defines permissions and allowed screens.

name.description: Client name (used for logging and ACL checks).

group.description: Group name associated with the client for permission checks.

screens.description: List of screen names this client is allowed to display (e.g., ['clock', 'uptime']).
